This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Kenobi I" /> [[Ayo Bons]]<ref name="Dawn Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a member of this species.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their dark, grooved skin, as well as a series of [[Bone|bony]] horns running vertically across the tops of their heads.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> a member of this species,<ref name="Kenobi I" /> [[Ayo Bons]],<ref name="Dawn Guide" /> worked as a member<ref name="Kenobi I" /> of the [[Black Mask]],<ref name="Dawn Guide" /> a small mercenary gang tasked by the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] to [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnap]] the [[Princess]] of [[Alderaan]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in order to lure the fugitive [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] out of hiding, a task they would temporarily succeed at, though Kenobi eventually rescued the princess, resulting in their leader, [[Vect Nokru]], being executed at the hands of the [[Grand Inquisitor]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in "[[Part I]]" of the limited television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'',<ref name="Kenobi I" /> which was released on [[May 26]], [[2022]]<ref name="Episode 1 Release">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref> Keeper of the [[Holocron]] [[Leland Chee]] revealed on [[Wikipedia:Discord|Discord]] on [[December 1]], [[2025]] that he treated this species the same as the species of a [[Unidentified horn-row Sith Lord|Sith Lord]] from the [[2010]] [[Star Wars Legends]] comic issue [[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]],<ref name="Leland Species 1">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-12-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1445130449054728343|quote=MANITOBAN was the production codename for anything related to Black Mask. Vidara Jurness has a species name but I don't know if it was ever published. Ayo Bons does not yet have a species name though I keyword that species as "spike mohawk." There was a similar unnamed character of what I assume is that species in the old Legacy comic series. I have a Holocron entry that tries to track "horn, spike, and plate-headed species" in the hopes that I can avoid naming a species twice.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-Manitoban-Discord.png}} {{C|In response to: "Hello @HolocronKeeper, back with what feels like my now-monthly species-related question that you may be able to shed some light on. We've seen this mysterious title crop up randomly across various places, in reference specifically to members of the Black Mask. "Manitoban" has been used by Bart Mixon in at least 3 different social media posts to refer to Ayo Bons, and some weird licensed Star Wars NFT someone discovered refers to Vidara Jurness as a Manitoban as well. Is this possibly like a species name for either of them that was accidentally applied to both, or maybe the original name for the Black Mask used in production, or just something totally different? I know Manitoban can also refer to IRL Manitoba in Canada as well, but from what I can tell, neither actor here is associated with that location, so I'm honestly at a loss."}}</ref><ref name="Leland Species 2">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-12-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1445136185998446804|quote=It's a Sith with a black ponytail in Legacy Extremes.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-LegacySithPonytail-Discord.png}} {{C|In response to: "Very good to finally have an answer, thank you as always! Guess I'll start digging through Legacy to try and pinpoint exactly which individual you're referring to, and cool to know unidentified comic species from back then still have a chance of being named/resurfacing someday. I'll let you know if for some reason I can't find it, and look forward to sending you another of my niche species questions probably next year lol!"}}</ref> written by both [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], and illustrated by the latter,<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-989/Star-Wars-Legacy-48---Extremes-Part-1|text=Star Wars: Legacy #48 - Extremes (Part 1)}}</ref> retconning a previous statement Duursema had made identifying the individual as a [[human]] with cranial horn implants.<ref name="Answer">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19441&p=260230#p260230|thread=Question for John or Jan regarding Legacy #48|user=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2012-06-26|time=08:55|quote=That Sith was human--with a lot of tats and some spike implants on his skull.}}</ref> During that conversation, Chee also revealed that, as of that day, this species still did not have a name within the HCD, with the previously speculated "Manitoban" only being a production name for anything related to the [[Black Mask]] gang and its members, Ayo Bons included.<ref name="Leland Species 1" />
